SPOTIFY

Connect Spotify

Use your own Spotify app and account. Spotify Premium is required. The sample library works without signing in.

First time? Set up your Spotify app +
  1. Open the Spotify Developer Dashboard ↗ and create an app. Choose Web API and Web Playback SDK.
  2. In the app settings, register this exact redirect URI:
  3. Copy its Client ID into the field above. No client secret is needed. Use your own account. For other listeners, Spotify requires them to be added in your app’s User Management. Development apps have a five-user limit.
Never paste a client secret. Sign-in happens on Spotify. Tokens and your selected library stay in this tab’s session storage. Disconnect in Settings to clear them. There is no shared Spotify account.
MUSIC SOURCE

Choose your music.

Choose a collection. Its songs, artists, and albums become your iPod’s library.

Spotify may restrict playlist contents to playlists you own or collaborate on. Liked Songs is always supported after authorization.
A FAMILIAR KIND OF SIMPLE

A familiar kind of simple.

01

Spin to explore.

Drag around the wheel, use your mouse wheel, or press ↑ and ↓. Tap any screen row to open it directly.

02

Press to discover.

The centre button selects. MENU takes you back. Hold MENU to return home. / opens search.

03

Make it yours.

Choose Liked Songs or a playlist as your library. Spotify Search looks beyond that collection.

04

Keep it spinning.

Play, skip, shuffle, repeat, and queue. Select the centre on Now Playing to cycle volume and seek controls. The top HOLD switch locks the player. Use Pop out for an iPod-only window; closing it returns the player here.

An independent personal project inspired by the original iPod. Not affiliated with Apple or Spotify. No offline downloads or lyrics are offered through Spotify’s playback API.
PLAYBACK

Choose an output.

Listen in this browser or control another active Spotify device. Open Spotify on the other device first.
